title: kit.kit-head.v1
description: kit-main.json: what the kit's main is, published by the kit's own CI on every push to main (`kit vendor publish-head`, .github/workflows/kit-head.yml) to a public object (packages/core/registry/kit-head.json). The kit repository is private; its head commit is not secret. A site's `kit check vendor` reads it with no credential to bound how stale its vendored kit may be (vendor-stale, docs/RELEASE.md): `recent` lists main's first-parent commits newest first, so the number of commits a snapshot lacks is counted without the GitHub API.

recent.description: main's first-parent history, newest first; recent[0] is sha.

archive.description: The archive of sha (git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix=kit/), published to the same public bucket by the same run: what a site's bootstrap fetches with no credential (vendor.transport archive) and verifies against sha256 and bytes before unpacking it.
